data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：AI在医疗领域中的应用及其相关问题

不同观点：
• sibeliuss认为AI替代人力完成繁重、易出错的工作是合理的，但同时指出这会对劳动力市场产生影响。他对未来持乐观态度，但提醒需要关注劳动力市场的变化。
• candiddevmike对AI录入电子健康记录（EHRs）中的数据表示担忧，特别是涉及到过敏和药物等高风险信息。他质疑系统的准确性以及是否符合FDA的医疗设备认证要求，并询问是否与FDA合作进行AI医疗设备认证以及集成的EHRs系统。
• Mashimo分享了医院软件中使用API处理转诊的经历，并指出在人员调度上仍然存在手动操作的问题，耗费大量时间和精力。
• noleary对AI产品在不同诊所的采用情况表示兴趣，询问是否有特定类型的诊所更适合或更愿意采用此类AI产品。

补充讨论：
• terrib1e询问公司是否在招聘，并提到自己在政府合同管理方面有相关经验。
• MK_Dev对技术栈感兴趣，询问除了浏览器使用之外的其他技术细节。
• ahstilde关注AI代理如何符合HIPAA合规要求，特别是数据传输中的安全性。
• SuperNinKenDo的评论带有讽刺意味，似乎对AI服务的潜在后果表示不满。
• shashanoid的评论比较简短，提到浏览器中的logo，但没有深入讨论。

争议焦点：
• candiddevmike对AI在医疗记录中应用的准确性和合规性提出质疑，特别是涉及到高风险的医疗信息和FDA认证问题。这是讨论中的一个关键争议点，涉及到技术在医疗领域应用的安全性和合法性。

data.title: Denuvo Analysis
data.author: StefanBatory
data.article_summary:
这篇文章详细分析了Denuvo，一种成功的反篡改和数字版权管理（DRM）系统，主要用于保护游戏不被盗版和逆向工程。Denuvo通过独特的硬件验证和加密技术，确保游戏代码的完整性。其工作流程包括：

1. 首次启动程序时，Denuvo收集硬件信息并发送至服务器。
2. 服务器处理后返回一个许可证文件，包含加密常量和硬件信息。
3. 程序之后使用该文件进行本地验证，无需再次联网。
4. 程序执行时会检查当前硬件信息是否匹配，若不匹配则导致游戏崩溃。

Denuvo通过将部分指令移除并加密，存储在许可证文件中，只有合法用户才能正确解密并执行原始游戏指令。该系统复杂且难以破解，但也引发了对用户体验的争议。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：Denuvo DRM的技术细节、有效性及其影响

不同观点：
• **Denuvo的技术遗产与问题**：farmdve认为Denuvo继承了SecuROM时代的遗留技术（如UD2），并指出这种技术可能导致某些游戏在未来无法运行。他还详细解释了CPUID钩子与Windows异常处理的冲突问题，说明Denuvo在未来可能导致兼容性问题。
• **Denuvo的复杂性与混淆技术**：yukIttEft通过使用LLVM分解Denuvo的x86混淆代码，揭示其如何将游戏代码转换为基于栈机的虚拟机代码，并指出其中的多重赋值和混淆操作（如MBAs），使得破解非常困难。他还询问是否有LLVM优化器可以处理MBAs。
• **Denuvo的有效性**：rjh29认为Denuvo非常有效，因为即便在多年后，受Denuvo保护的游戏仍然未被破解，显示其强大的防破解能力。
• **独立开发者的DRM技术与市场困境**：2c2c2c分享了一个独立开发者朋友开发类似Denuvo的DRM技术但难以商业化的故事，并寻求建议。
• **消费者抵制与用户体验**：shmerl和tristor等用户主张通过不购买带有Denuvo的游戏来抵制这种DRM，tristor进一步表示Denuvo使得在Linux系统上玩游戏变得不可能，因此他拒绝购买相关游戏。mdaniel则抱怨Denuvo对正版用户的体验造成了负面影响。
• **对"盗版常量"或"盗版指令"的困惑**：flerchin对使用"stolen constants"或"stolen instructions"这样的术语表示困惑，认为用"拦截"可能更合适。
• **对Empress和破解社区的讨论**：Traubenfuchs提到了著名的Denuvo破解者Empress，并对其在网络上的古怪表现进行了评论，而larodi和cainxinth则期待Empress的分析。
• **DRM与游戏产业的未来**：doctorpangloss认为Denuvo为单人PC游戏提供了防盗版选项，并指出游戏产业可以选择多人在线或其他环境完整性技术来防止盗版。他还认为反对Denuvo的运动具有讽刺意味，因为Denuvo实际上保护了那些希望通过单人游戏获取收益的开发者。

补充讨论：
• **对DRM和游戏价值的广泛看法**：menthe认为DRM只是繁琐的技术工作，不值得重视，并认为大多数AAA游戏不值得玩，推荐独立游戏或经典游戏。
• **对技术复杂性和创新的讨论**：一些评论提到了Denuvo复杂的混淆技术（如MBAs）以及破解过程中的技术挑战，反映了DRM开发与破解之间的技术对抗。

争议焦点：
• **Denuvo对正版用户体验的影响**：一部分用户（如mdaniel和tristor）认为Denuvo严重影响了正版用户的体验，而另一部分用户（如doctorpangloss）则认为Denuvo对游戏产业的防盗版措施至关重要，并认为反对Denuvo的运动忽视了开发者的利益。

Denuvo Analysis
Posted on
2025-01-21
• 3805 words
• 18 minute read
Foreword
This post is intended for educational purposes only. Denuvo is arguably the most successful digital rights management solution to have ever existed, and is therefore an interest to many. This blog contains a large amount of my personal notes and correspondence with other reverse engineers (see
kudos
) which contains information about the recent iterations of Denuvo, lots of which I haven’t seen shared publicly before.
I mean no harm towards Irdeto and thus certain information will be redacted from this post.
Denuvo
Denuvo is an anti-tamper and digital rights management system (DRM). It is primarily used to protect digital media such as video games from piracy and reverse engineering efforts. Unlike traditional DRM systems, Denuvo employs a wide range of unique techniques and checks to confirm the integrity of both the game’s code and licensed user.
The General Idea
The core idea behind Denuvo is nothing new. It can only be described as a semi-online DRM for reasons that will become clear shortly. The general idea is as follows:
(1)
User boots program.exe for the first time.
(2)
Before any original game code is executed, Denuvo will collect hardware identification information regarding the current system, and prepare it for sending over the internet.
(3)
program.exe then sends this hardware information to a Denuvo hosted server. What occurs at the server is obviously a mystery, but it likely applies reversible mathematical functions to combine the “stolen constants” (more on those later) with the hardware information provided by program.exe. The server then sends this now mixed information, we will refer to this as “the license file”, back to program.exe.
(4)
Once program.exe receives the license file, a local copy is created that program.exe can refer to on future boots; removing the need for another online request to be made (hence the use of “semi-online” earlier).
(5)
program.exe will be redirected to the original entry point (OEP) and begin executing the actual game code. During this time, program.exe will collect hardware information at runtime and attempt to decrypt stolen constants from the license file. These now decrypted constants will then be used to execute “original game instructions”.
If it wasn’t made clear already, the game will effectively end up performing user integrity checks. This is due to the fact that if the hardware information collected at runtime is not the equal to that of which was used to create the license file on the Denuvo server, then an incorrect stolen constant will be decrypted and the game will likely suffer (most of the time this is a direct crash).
A More Technical Explanation
This section will investigate each protection mechanism and user integrity check more thoroughly. Remember, there is far more to Denuvo that what is outlined here.
General Idea Revisited
License File
When Denuvo is first added to a binary, certain functions in that game are selected to become “protected”. All this means is that the function itself will be executed inside of a virtual machine, and select parts of certain instructions will be removed entirely from the binary. The license file is simply all of these removed bytes combined together and combined with the user’s hardware identification via reversible mathematical functions. It is important that whatever operations are applied are reversible, otherwise the client would have no way of decrypting and getting the original constant.
License DWORDs
Since there are multiple stolen instructions, prior to handling execution over to the OEP, Denuvo will write select parts of the license file into DWORDs, scattered around the .vm section (.vm being the PE section which contains the VM code). Each DWORD, we will nick “License DWORD”, is effectively a single instruction that was removed from the binary, combined with the hardware identification information of the customer.

data.title: Finding Atari Games in Randomly Generated Data
data.author: wanderingjew
data.article_summary: 本文介绍了通过随机数据生成并筛选出可能的Atari 2600游戏的实验项目。作者利用GPU生成数十亿个4KB的随机数据文件，通过模拟器运行并筛选出潜在的游戏。由于Atari 2600游戏卡带数据量有限，理论上有极大量的可能组合，但绝大多数是无意义的。为提高效率，作者使用了一些启发式方法，如检查有效操作码（opcode）的频率，以过滤掉明显的无用数据。最终，通过这种大规模随机生成和筛选，找到了一些有趣但未必有实际价值的"游戏"。该项目展示了利用现代计算能力探索巨大可能性空间的过程。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：随机生成有效ROM并探索其可能性

不同观点：
• **selcuka**：分享了一个个人经历，讲述了由于磁带加载错误，意外修改了游戏代码，导致游戏无限续命。他认为这种情况虽然不如从头写一个游戏的概率低，但仍然很有趣。
• **jerf**：认为通过在生成阶段使用接受标准来优化随机ROM生成是一种有效的方法，相当于快速生成有意义的输出，而不是浪费资源在无用的结果上。
• **staplung**：将该实验比作博尔赫斯的《巴别图书馆》，并通过计算指出可能的ROM组合数量巨大，甚至超过可观测宇宙的规模。
• **a_cardboard_box**：指出这些随机生成的ROM虽然在模拟器上显示动态或结构化数据，但不太可能在实际的电视或游戏机上正确运行，尤其是由于VSync信号问题。
• **tdjsnelling**：赞赏这个概念，并提到自己的项目“Library of Babel”应用。
• **JetSetIlly**：提到最简单的2600游戏只有2K大小，如Combat，建议限制大小为2K以增加找到完整ROM的机会。
• **edent**：幽默地提到在实验中可能会忽视外界的重要变化，如星星熄灭。
• **mjd**：认为这是他见过的“最愚蠢”但令人惊叹的项目之一。
• **xhrpost**：提到类似的项目“Pulling JPEGs From Thin Air”，通过随机生成数据来产生有效图像。
• **jsnider3**：建议通过从Atari游戏的汇编代码中随机采样来生成游戏，而不是依赖LLM生成。
• **coldcity**：分享了自己以前做过类似的实验，使用32字节的DOS程序和基本的遗传编程。
• **p0w3n3d**：质疑从随机生成游戏到生成可在Atari上运行的内容的转变，认为随机生成的数据可能包含部分游戏元素，但不太可能生成完整游戏。
• **mock-possum**：对实验结果感到兴奋，希望作者能进一步探索可能出现的结果。
• **_benj**：认为这是一个非常有趣的实验，提到自己曾做过类似的实验，探索理性数模式。
• **wannabebarista**：认为项目有趣，但对模拟器产生的噪音感到惊吓。

补充讨论：
• 争议焦点之一是随机生成数据是否能真正生成有效的、可运行的游戏ROM。
• 讨论中多次提到博尔赫斯的《巴别图书馆》，将其作为理解随机生成巨大可能性的比喻。
• 对项目实际运行效果和在不同设备上的表现存在一定质疑，尤其是实际电视和游戏机上的运行情况。
• 对优化随机生成过程的方法进行了探讨，包括使用接受标准和限制ROM大小。
• 项目被普遍认为有趣且具有探索价值，但也有人对其实际效果持怀疑态度。

Finite Atari Machine
Finding Atari Games in Randomly Generated Data
TL;DR,
here’s the GitHub repo
This project generated around 30 Billion individual 4kB files of random data. These files were winnowed down to about 10,000 through some heuristics gleaned from the complete collection of Atari ROM files. Finally, a classifier system scanned them using an Atari 2600 emulator to see if any of these random files were actually an Atari game. This project answers a question no one asked, no one wanted, and is a massive waste of resources: What if I shove a billion monkeys in a GPU and asked them to write a game for the Atari 2600?
Thanks to advances in GPUs, AI, and machine learning, we can now (very quickly) write a Python script that dumps garbage into 4KB ROMs and asks,
“does this look like a game?”
This isn’t nostalgia, because my first console was an NES. This is about exploring something unimaginably vast and seeing if anything weird falls out.
Results First
Because no one reads below the fold, here’s an interactive emulator showcasing the most interesting Atari ROMs discovered. There’s no genetic algorithm here; just billions of random files run through an emulator. These are the best of the weird:
WARNING: turn your volume down. There’s a bug in
EmulatorJS
.
Problem Scope
Assume each Atari 2600 cartridge is a 4 kilobyte chunk of data. It’s a maximum of 4096 bytes, or 32,768 bits. That means there are $2^{32768}$ possible ROMs. For perspective:
That’s $10^{10159}$ potential Atari games.
There are about $10^{20}$ grains of sand on Earth.
And roughly $10^{80}$ protons in the visible universe.
If you turned an entire datacenter of AI compute boxes onto this problem, it would likely take years before anything interesting was found. But with a little bit of smarts and actually reading a datasheet, the problem set is massively reduced. The basic search path to finding a ‘random’ Atari game would be to:
Generate a ROM, by dumping 4kB of data from /dev/random into a file.
Run that file in an emulator
Capture a screenshot or five
Filter or score them with AI
Save the best results for further investigation.
This would work, if we had enough time to wait for black holes to devour the Universe. A better idea would be to front-load the pipeline with some simple checks to discard the absolute garbage before spinning up an emulator. It would help to know what a real Atari ROM would look like, simply to build some heuristics.
Heuristics
I’m not going to emulate every possible ROM. I’m trying to find the
interesting
ones. This means filtering, and being smart about what we’re doing:
Opcode Sanity
The 6507 CPU (from here on out I’m calling it a 6502, to make you, specifically, angry) has 151 valid opcodes, and these opcodes are going to be all over the first half of the ROM. First I should check if there are a lot of opcodes in the data. These opcodes are:
0x00, 0x01, 0x05, 0x06, 0x08, 0x09, 0x0A, 0x0D, 0x0E, 0x10, 0x11, 0x15, 0x16, 0x18,
0x19, 0x1D, 0x1E, 0x20, 0x21, 0x24, 0x25, 0x26, 0x28, 0x29, 0x2A, 0x2C, 0x2D, 0x2E,
0x30, 0x31, 0x35, 0x36, 0x38, 0x39, 0x3D, 0x3E, 0x40, 0x41, 0x45, 0x46, 0x48, 0x49,
0x4A, 0x4C, 0x4D, 0x4E, 0x50, 0x51, 0x55, 0x56, 0x58, 0x59, 0x5D, 0x5E, 0x60, 0x61,
0x65, 0x66, 0x68, 0x69, 0x6A, 0x6C, 0x6D, 0x6E, 0x70, 0x71, 0x75, 0x76, 0x78, 0x79,
0x7D, 0x7E, 0x81, 0x84, 0x85, 0x86, 0x88, 0x8A, 0x8C, 0x8D, 0x8E, 0x90, 0x91, 0x94,
0x95, 0x96, 0x98, 0x99, 0x9A, 0x9D, 0xA0, 0xA1, 0xA2, 0xA4, 0xA5, 0xA6, 0xA8, 0xA9,
0xAA, 0xAC, 0xAD, 0xAE, 0xB0, 0xB1, 0xB4, 0xB5, 0xB6, 0xB8, 0xB9, 0xBA, 0xBC, 0xBD,
0xBE, 0xC0, 0xC1, 0xC4, 0xC5, 0xC6, 0xC8, 0xC9, 0xCA, 0xCC, 0xCD, 0xCE, 0xD0, 0xD1,
0xD5, 0xD6, 0xD8, 0xD9, 0xDD, 0xDE, 0xE0, 0xE1, 0xE4, 0xE5, 0xE6, 0xE8, 0xE9, 0xEA,
0xEC, 0xED, 0xEE, 0xF0, 0xF1, 0xF5, 0xF6, 0xF8, 0xF9, 0xFD, 0xFE

44236900.article_summary: 本文介绍了通过随机数据生成并筛选出可能的Atari 2600游戏的实验项目。作者利用GPU生成数十亿个4KB的随机数据文件，通过模拟器运行并筛选出潜在的游戏。由于Atari 2600游戏卡带数据量有限，理论上有极大量的可能组合，但绝大多数是无意义的。为提高效率，作者使用了一些启发式方法，如检查有效操作码（opcode）的频率，以过滤掉明显的无用数据。最终，通过这种大规模随机生成和筛选，找到了一些有趣但未必有实际价值的"游戏"。该项目展示了利用现代计算能力探索巨大可能性空间的过程。
44236900.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：随机生成有效ROM并探索其可能性

不同观点：
• **selcuka**：分享了一个个人经历，讲述了由于磁带加载错误，意外修改了游戏代码，导致游戏无限续命。他认为这种情况虽然不如从头写一个游戏的概率低，但仍然很有趣。
• **jerf**：认为通过在生成阶段使用接受标准来优化随机ROM生成是一种有效的方法，相当于快速生成有意义的输出，而不是浪费资源在无用的结果上。
• **staplung**：将该实验比作博尔赫斯的《巴别图书馆》，并通过计算指出可能的ROM组合数量巨大，甚至超过可观测宇宙的规模。
• **a_cardboard_box**：指出这些随机生成的ROM虽然在模拟器上显示动态或结构化数据，但不太可能在实际的电视或游戏机上正确运行，尤其是由于VSync信号问题。
• **tdjsnelling**：赞赏这个概念，并提到自己的项目“Library of Babel”应用。
• **JetSetIlly**：提到最简单的2600游戏只有2K大小，如Combat，建议限制大小为2K以增加找到完整ROM的机会。
• **edent**：幽默地提到在实验中可能会忽视外界的重要变化，如星星熄灭。
• **mjd**：认为这是他见过的“最愚蠢”但令人惊叹的项目之一。
• **xhrpost**：提到类似的项目“Pulling JPEGs From Thin Air”，通过随机生成数据来产生有效图像。
• **jsnider3**：建议通过从Atari游戏的汇编代码中随机采样来生成游戏，而不是依赖LLM生成。
• **coldcity**：分享了自己以前做过类似的实验，使用32字节的DOS程序和基本的遗传编程。
• **p0w3n3d**：质疑从随机生成游戏到生成可在Atari上运行的内容的转变，认为随机生成的数据可能包含部分游戏元素，但不太可能生成完整游戏。
• **mock-possum**：对实验结果感到兴奋，希望作者能进一步探索可能出现的结果。
• **_benj**：认为这是一个非常有趣的实验，提到自己曾做过类似的实验，探索理性数模式。
• **wannabebarista**：认为项目有趣，但对模拟器产生的噪音感到惊吓。

补充讨论：
• 争议焦点之一是随机生成数据是否能真正生成有效的、可运行的游戏ROM。
• 讨论中多次提到博尔赫斯的《巴别图书馆》，将其作为理解随机生成巨大可能性的比喻。
• 对项目实际运行效果和在不同设备上的表现存在一定质疑，尤其是实际电视和游戏机上的运行情况。
• 对优化随机生成过程的方法进行了探讨，包括使用接受标准和限制ROM大小。
• 项目被普遍认为有趣且具有探索价值，但也有人对其实际效果持怀疑态度。

data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：关于电视节目"Mr. M"（M先生）的回忆与评价

不同观点：
• [atum47] 提到M先生的经典台词“explain that, Mr. M”在日常生活中仍然被用来质疑不正常的情况，并举例说明。
• [rmellow] 回忆M先生的节目因其在巴西非法工作而被联邦警察拘留的事件，并提供相关新闻链接。
• [d0100] 对M先生因“巴西人痛恨欺骗”而走红的说法提出质疑，认为他走红是因为魔术的魅力以及当时电视作为唯一免费视觉媒体的独特地位。
• [elros] 表达了对M先生节目的怀旧情感，提到听到主持人Cid Moreira的声音就能勾起童年回忆，并分享了相关视频链接。
• [jwitthuhn] 提供了M先生节目在YouTube上的观看链接，方便未看过该节目的人观看。
• [silisili] 认为节目中“所有魔术师都讨厌他”的说法只是为了增加节目效果，并指出魔术本质上是表演而非真实。
• [scop] 回忆童年时对M先生节目的喜爱，认为该节目揭示了魔术背后的技巧和表演艺术，使电视魔术更加有趣和真实。
• [mikaelmello] 对文章中将M先生称为“英雄”表示不满，认为这是夸大其词，并指出在巴西M先生只是众多知名人物之一，并没有特别突出。

补充讨论：
• [felipellrocha]、[felineflock]、[wblackfield]、[DocTomoe]、[lee-rhapsody]、[bookofjoe]等人主要以调侃、分享链接或简短评论为主，没有深入讨论。
• [pearlsontheroad] 提到与讨论主题无关的关于巴西老年办公室职员的雇佣问题，属于离题讨论。

争议焦点：
• M先生是否因“巴西人痛恨欺骗”而走红，还是因为电视媒体的独特地位和魔术本身的魅力。
• 对M先生在巴西是否被视为“英雄”的评价存在分歧，有人认为这是夸大其词。

data.title: Show HN: A “Course” as an MCP Server
data.author: codekarate
data.article_summary:
Mastra 101是一门由Mastra大学的首席产品官Shane Thomas讲解的互动课程，旨在教授如何使用Mastra平台开发和部署AI代理。课程由MCP代理引导，包含三个主要课程，未来将增加更多内容，预计12小时完成。课程全程在代理代码编辑器内进行，代理会逐步指导并协助编写代码，帮助构建具备工具、记忆和MCP功能的实际代理。

课程大纲包括：
1. **构建首个代理**：设置开发环境，构建并部署能从外部来源读取数据、使用自定义工具和记忆之前互动的代理。
2. **添加工具和MCP**：通过MCP服务器连接外部服务，集成电子邮件、社交媒体、GitHub等工具。
3. **添加记忆**：配置代理的记忆功能，使其能够记住对话和用户偏好。

常见问题包括MCP服务器在不同编辑器和系统上的安装问题。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：围绕LLM（大型语言模型）编程框架的使用体验、跨平台兼容性、课程学习方式以及技术实现的可能性展开的讨论。

不同观点：
• Gorath认为LLM编程并没有带来预期的巨大优势，尤其是在处理问题和上下文理解方面，使用过程中遇到了循环问题，最终放弃。
• keeganpoppen对Mastra框架表示赞赏，认为其设计简洁且符合实际工作需求，相较于其他框架更加实用。
• hofo作为新手，关注不同AI平台间创建代理的可移植性，询问这些平台的概念是否类似但实现细节不同。
• tmaly对技术实现表现出兴趣，计划寻找适合的模型来运行并与该技术互动。
• jcmontx和justanotheratom关注课程的实际操作步骤，询问如何开始以及是否可以提供视频教程。
• davecyen将该技术与Codecademy对比，认为这是下一代编程学习方式。
• ninkendo对技术标题有不同理解，设想LLM能否自主完成在线大学课程，认为这在当前是可能的。
• avipeltz询问课程内容是否涵盖工作流而不仅仅是代理的制作。
• hoppp对网站的移动端表现提出批评，认为在手机上浏览体验不佳。

补充讨论：
• 讨论中涉及对不同框架的评价（如Mastra的简洁性）和对LLM编程的实际效果评价（Gorath的负面体验）。
• 初学者关注技术跨平台兼容性问题（hofo），而更有经验的用户则关注技术实现细节（tmaly，avipeltz）。
• 用户对课程的具体操作步骤和学习资源（视频教程）有需求（jcmontx，justanotheratom）。
• 网站移动端体验问题（hoppp）也被提及，显示出用户对界面设计和兼容性的关注。

data.author: psnehanshu
data.article_summary: XenevaOS 是一个从头构建的操作系统，支持 x86_64 和 ARM64 架构。其内核名为 "Aurora"，采用混合内核设计，整个系统称为 "Xeneva"。该系统具有多种功能，包括 ACPI 支持、x64 和 ARM64 内核、高半内存、驱动加载、SSE/SSE3、USB3、Intel 高清音频、多处理器支持等。它还包括一个名为 "Deodhai" 的合成窗口管理器，一个名为 "Chitralekha" 的图形库，以及一个支持基本 ANSI/VT100 转义序列的终端。此外，Xeneva 还提供音频服务器、网络支持以及多种应用程序和驱动。该项目欢迎开发者贡献代码、文档、错误报告和功能建议，并且主要在 Windows 环境下构建。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：针对XenevaOS项目的不同观点和讨论

不同观点：
• **项目团队介绍及目标**  
  - **Team Xeneva的观点**: XenevaOS是由两位开发者组成的团队项目，最初是Manas的个人爱好项目，现在已发展为针对现代计算和硬件的专业操作系统项目。目标是扩展操作系统的潜力到多个领域，如汽车、机器人、医疗科学，特别是AR/VR/XR，优先考虑用户需求而非软件依赖。
  - **einpoklum的观点**: 质疑项目的开发背景和目的，询问项目是个人爱好还是具有其他目的（如学术或商业），并提出为何要全面开发内核、低层服务、图形桌面环境和应用程序。

• **技术设计与实现细节**  
  - **namr2000的观点**: 对系统的设计提出具体问题，包括是否类似于Unix系统、是否支持libc、IPC机制的原理以及对象格式。
  - **jrapdx3的观点**: 指出项目在Windows下构建，虽然提供了详细的构建说明，但构建环境非常具体，且不支持Windows native Hyper-V。建议提供与其他操作系统的比较以吸引贡献者。
  - **vkaku的观点**: 赞赏非Unix/POSIX风格的操作系统，鼓励更多人尝试非标准实现。

• **项目独特性与社区反馈**  
  - **yyyk的观点**: 强调新操作系统需要与现有系统有明显区别，以吸引社区注意。
  - **ThinkBeat的观点**: 赞赏项目不为Unix风格操作系统，认为尝试其他路径具有重要价值。

• **开源与许可证问题**  
  - **snvzz的观点**: 质疑项目是否真正开源，因未能找到明确的许可证信息。

• **用户体验与技术支持**  
  - **not-so-darkstar的观点**: 分享自己多次尝试编写操作系统失败的经历，询问开发者的历程和经验。
  - **patrick4urcloud的观点**: 询问是否有ISO文件可以在虚拟机中尝试。

补充讨论：
• **社区兴趣与反馈**  
  - **unixhero的观点**: 认为项目看起来非常酷。
  - **cess11的观点**: 提供了一个包含可能过时的说明的视频链接。

• **开发工作分配与优先级**  
  - **rbanffy的观点**: 质疑同时关注核心功能和表现层是否会导致开发工作过于分散。

争议焦点：
• 项目是否应明确技术细节和设计原理以吸引更多贡献者。
• 项目是否真正开源及其许可证问题。
• 新操作系统如何在技术实现和独特性上与其他操作系统区分开来。

XenevaOS
Xeneva is an operating system for both x86_64 and ARM64  architectures, built from the ground up. The Kernel is known as
'Aurora'
with hybrid kernel design and the entire operating system is known as
'Xeneva'
.
Please visit
Build Instructions
to build the project
Documentation
Refer to
Documentations of XenevaOS
Contributing to the project
XenevaOS is an open-source project that welcomes contributions from developers, researchers, and enthusiasts who are passionate about low level system development. Whether you're intereseted in Kernel development, driver development, low level graphics or application level features there are many ways to get involved. We encourage contibutions in the form of code, documentation, bug reports, and feature suggestions. If you're interested in contibuting, check out out
Contribution Guideline
, explore open issues, and join the discussion to help shape the project.
Features
:
ACPI (through acpica)
x64 and arm64 Kernel
Fully Higher Half Memory with MMIO mappings
Driver
loading and linking
through dll files
SSE/SSE3
USB3
Intel High Definition Audio
Multiprocessor support (muliprocessor scheduler not ready !!)
Application loader and dynamic library (shared library)
Freetype2 as font rendering engine
Compositing Window Manager called "Deodhai"
Graphics Library known as "Chitralekha"
Xeneva Terminal with basic ANSI/VT100 escape sequence support
Desktop environment called Namdapha Desktop
Storage supports : AHCI/SATA, NVMe
USB3 Class drivers (USB HID Mouse, USB Tablet, USB MSC driver) ..etc
Audio Server called "Deodhai-Audio" with
(44kHz/16bit audio format, stereo/mono panning, gain control)
Networking (IPv4, UDP/IP, TCP/IP, ICMP)
And many more coming soon
Screenshot:
AppTray:
Installed Applications :
Audio player called Accent Player
File Browser
Calculator
Xeneva Terminal (ANSI/VT100 support)
XEShell
Audio Server called (DeodhaiAudio)
play (
CLI Application
)
piano (
CLI Application
)
Calender
Background Serivices like - Net Manager
Building the project
The project is build purely on Windows Environment. Please Visit
Build Instructions page
for more information

data.title: Detection of hidden cellular GPS vehicle trackers
data.author: gnabgib
data.article_summary: 无法获取文章内容
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：车辆中安装的追踪设备及其相关技术、安全和隐私问题

不同观点：
• [aggregator-ios] 认为这些追踪设备可能由大型经销商安装，而不是制造商，且可能与LoJak销售或保险追踪有关。设备通常插入OBD端口，并可能导致电动车电池的异常消耗。如果介意，可以自行移除。
• [seethishat] 指出业余无线电爱好者几十年来一直在使用APRS进行追踪，认为即使是老旧车辆也可以被追踪，带有一定的调侃意味。
• [eschneider] 提出大多数追踪设备使用运动传感器进入低功耗模式，只有在移动时才会传输信号，提醒如果要追踪需要注意这一点。
• [theoreticalmal] 表示其行业涉及IoT追踪设备，提到在非洲等地，这些设备可能被用于盗车，通过GPS干扰和无线电定位技术。
• [vv_] 认为使用RTL-SDR和LTE天线比购买专业设备更便宜，但对普通人来说，检测这些信号并不容易，因为IoT使用的频段也包含正常LTE信号。
• [goda90] 担心如果与执法人员有关系的人试图追踪，会更加容易，并提供了相关链接支持其观点。
• [userbinator] 提出使用EMP来摧毁车辆中的追踪设备，特别是对于无电子设备的机械柴油车。
• [weinzierl] 认为尝试隐藏位置数据已经不太可能，数据已经成为商品，建议不要假设可以永久隐藏。
• [Daviey] 指出相关研究未考虑到技术被犯罪分子利用的可能性，他们可以利用这些技术找到合法的追踪器并进行盗窃。

补充讨论：
• 讨论中涉及的技术包括OBD端口设备、APRS、运动传感器、EMP等。
• 隐私和安全是主要关注点，特别是设备未披露安装以及可能被犯罪利用的问题。
• 争议焦点在于如何有效检测和移除追踪设备，以及普通人是否具备相关技术能力。
• 讨论还涉及到更广泛的数据隐私问题，认为位置数据已经成为难以隐藏的商品。

data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：用户对一个单词猜测游戏的反馈和建议

不同观点：
• [tmulc18] 认为如果页面顶部有字母表，游戏会更有趣，因为他们因为忘记字母顺序而犯了错误。
• [flipnotyk] 遇到了拼写错误的问题（"Negociate"），并指出词库可能有问题，因为字典网站无法找到该词。
• [veganjay] 对游戏表示赞赏，并分享了类似游戏的链接。
• [salamanderman] 提到使用二分查找法玩游戏，并表示与伴侣一起玩很有趣。
• [gcr] 对只有首字母高亮表示不满，认为这是一个bug。
• [jmpavlec] 对游戏自称是全球"最受欢迎的"猜测游戏表示怀疑，并询问是否会有每日一词或随机词的机制。

补充讨论：
• [radpanda] 更喜欢另一个网站（alphaguess.com）的简单界面。
• [ynac] 对游戏的匹配机制感到困惑，怀疑是否只匹配单词的前两个字母。
• [csnizik] 对游戏的创意表示赞赏，并提出了技术上的建议以解决延迟问题。
• [cardamomo] 表示游戏在接近猜中时停止响应，刷新后进度丢失，但总体上对游戏有积极评价。
• [glaucon] 报告了一个技术问题，即在使用Firefox/Windows时，输入'mountain'收到错误提示。
• [pardner] 对游戏的界面设计表示赞赏，并询问是否会考虑报告用户的猜测次数数据。
• [aqme28] 认为最佳策略是二分查找法，但实时想出最佳选择很困难。
• [sarpdag] 觉得游戏有趣，但不确定是否会再次玩。
• [layer8] 对游戏自称是全球最受欢迎的猜测游戏表示调侃。

争议焦点：
- 游戏是否应提供更多提示，如字母表（[tmulc18]）。
- 词库的准确性和拼写问题（[flipnotyk]）。
- 高亮反馈是否是bug（[gcr]）。
- 游戏自称是全球"最受欢迎的"猜测游戏的合理性（[jmpavlec], [layer8]）。

data.title: OpenAI o3-pro
data.author: mfiguiere
data.article_summary: 无法获取文章内容
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：围绕不同GPT模型版本（如o3-pro、o4-mini等）的性能、实用性和价格的讨论。

不同观点：
• **技术细节与使用体验**：
  ◦ [DanMcInerney] 希望GPT5能在性能上有显著提升，并提到每个新版本在实际任务中表现更好，尽管基准测试显示的改进不大。他建议专门针对任务导向数据进行训练。
  ◦ [eru] 正在测试o3-pro，发现其处理算法问题时速度较慢，且UI经常超时，特别是Android和MacOS应用。
  ◦ [ikerino] 对o3-pro感到失望，认为其输出与常规o3差别不大。

• **模型性能的量化与比较**：
  ◦ [chad1n] 猜测o3-pro可能是最初的o3-preview，而o3可能是其量化版本，并希望有人对模型进行质量对比测试。
  ◦ [manmal] 质疑Pro模型是否仅比基础模型略好，并提出是否人工智能性能提升已接近上限的疑问。

• **价格与性价比**：
  ◦ [mark_l_watson] 不愿升级到Pro账户，尽管负担得起，但怀疑LLM是否是实现其对强大AI梦想的最终路径，并对当前的AI热潮持保留态度。
  ◦ [WhitneyLand] 认为o3已经非常强大，并偏好它超过Anthropic 4和Gemini 2.5，指出高级推理模型在代码生成和编辑中具有显著优势，但成本是需要考虑的因素。

• **其他工具与替代方案**：
  ◦ [honeybadger1] 认为Gemini在速度和准确性上仍然领先。
  ◦ [nickandbadger1] 分享了一个与图像生成相关的示例，转移了话题焦点。

• **价格变动与市场策略**：
  ◦ [ChrisArchitect] 提到OpenAI大幅降低o3价格，并提供相关链接。
  ◦ [tiahura] 讨论了升级到Teams账户和增加o3使用的可能性，并将其与Claude Max的费用进行比较。

补充讨论：
• [paul7986] 抱怨GPT的图像创建功能不足，特别是在生成实用图像时出现错误，强调其在实际应用中的局限性。

争议焦点：
• 主要集中在模型的实际性能提升是否显著，以及Pro版本是否物有所值。用户对新版本的期望与实际体验之间存在差距。

总结：讨论围绕模型的性能、价格、实用性及替代方案展开，用户对新版本的性能提升和价格策略持不同看法，部分用户对AI发展持谨慎态度。

data.title: A Family of Non-Periodic Tilings, Describable Using Elementary Tools
data.author: joshu
data.article_summary: 本文介绍了一种使用基本工具（如模算术和向量几何）构造的非周期性铺砖方法。这些铺砖展示了一种新的结构规律性，称为模错列旋转对称。该构造独立于先前的铺砖理论，包含12张图示和13页内容，提交至组合数学领域。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：非周期性铺砖的区别与应用

不同观点：
• tocs3认为，虽然注意到这篇论文，但对内容理解可能有困难，并关注这些瓷砖与其他非周期性铺砖的区别。他表现出对具体技术细节的兴趣，但尚未深入阅读。

• jameshart则从应用角度出发，建议将这些数学产生的美学上有用的瓷砖形状引入瓷砖制造商或铺路石制造商的视野中。他强调了这些形状在实际应用中的潜力，特别是与六边形铺砖的对比。

• 0y提供了有关图5(b)中图案的来源信息，指出该图案最早由Jan Sallmann-Räder在社交媒体上发布，并提供了链接以供参考。这显示了对图案原创性和传播路径的关注。

• joshu补充了论文的全标题，并指出这些图案是Miki Imura的螺旋镶嵌。他提供了有关该研究的更多背景信息，识别出具体的研究者及其贡献。

补充讨论：
• 争议的焦点可能在于这些新非周期性铺砖的具体技术细节和实际应用价值。tocs3表现出对理解这些细节的兴趣，而jameshart则更关注其实际应用和美学价值。

• 0y和joshu提供了有关图案来源和研究者背景的补充信息，帮助其他讨论者更好地理解这些图案的历史和学术背景。

• 讨论还涉及到社交媒体在学术和艺术图案传播中的作用，0y提供的链接显示了社交媒体在图案传播和共享中的影响。

Abstract:
We present a construction of a family of non-periodic tilings using elementary tools such as modular arithmetic and vector geometry. These tilings exhibit a distinct type of structural regularity, which we term modulo-staggered rotational symmetry. The construction is self-contained and does not rely on previous tiling theories or systems.

data.title: Modern Minimal Perfect Hashing: A Survey
data.author: matt_d
data.article_summary: 本文综述了现代最小完美哈希函数的研究进展。给定一个包含 $n$ 个键的集合 $S$，完美哈希函数能将这些键无碰撞地映射到前 $m \geq n$ 个整数，其中最小完美哈希函数满足 $m = n$。现代最小完美哈希函数在查询速度、空间效率和扩展性方面取得了显著进展，能够有效处理数十亿个键。不同方法在空间消耗、构建时间和查询时间上各有权衡。本文总结了最新发展，并通过大量实验评估指导实际应用中的选择。该技术广泛应用于静态哈希表、数据库、生物信息学和字符串学等领域。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：完美哈希（Perfect Hashing）的应用、优势、实现方式及其在实际开发中的限制和挑战。

不同观点：
• [tmostak] 认为完美哈希在数据库系统（如HeavyDB）中非常有效，尤其是在强分组和连接性能方面。他指出，完美哈希不仅适用于整数和字典编码字符串，还可以用于分箱数值和日期范围等场景。他也提到，虽然需要一个好的基线哈希路径作为后备，但很多实际应用都可以通过完美哈希获得显著性能提升。

• [hinkley] 认为完美哈希的讨论有些学术化，因为前期成本往往较高。不过，现代编程语言能够在编译时运行函数，从而实现静态查找表。他提到一个使用完美哈希加速接口/特性函数调用的研究，显示了其在特定场景下的应用潜力。

• [o11c] 分享了一个纯算术的练习，尝试对ASCII符号进行唯一哈希，并强调了避免使用大数组以减少不必要的资源消耗。他认为分支预测和乘法等操作对性能的影响需要仔细考虑。

• [throwaway81523] 认为完美哈希在某些领域比预想的重要，特别是近年来有很多新发展。他改变了对完美哈希仅为理论优化的看法，承认其在实际应用中的重要性。

• [vlovich123] 提到文章未涵盖最快的多重完美哈希函数（boomphf），并指出其在实践中遇到的性能优势。

• [rurban] 指出文章忽略了查询启动时间，这对整体性能影响显著。他还提到预编译哈希变体的挑战，尤其是C++中的错误。对于小规模数据，gperf仍然是速度最快的选择。

补充讨论：
• 完美哈希在实际应用中的前期成本和启动时间是争议的焦点，部分评论者认为这些成本限制了其广泛应用。
• 不同的哈希函数和实现方式（如boomphf、pthash、gperf）在性能和适用场景上的差异被多次提及，显示出在选择具体实现时需要仔细权衡。
• 评论中还讨论了现代编程语言和编译技术如何通过静态查找表等技术优化完美哈希的实现和应用。

Title:
Modern Minimal Perfect Hashing: A Survey
Authors:
Hans-Peter Lehmann
,
Thomas Mueller
,
Rasmus Pagh
,
Giulio Ermanno Pibiri
,
Peter Sanders
,
Sebastiano Vigna
,
Stefan Walzer
View a PDF of the paper titled Modern Minimal Perfect Hashing: A Survey, by Hans-Peter Lehmann and 6 other authors
View PDF
Abstract:
Given a set $S$ of $n$ keys, a perfect hash function for $S$ maps the keys in $S$ to the first $m \geq n$ integers without collisions. It may return an arbitrary result for any key not in $S$ and is called minimal if $m = n$. The most important parameters are its space consumption, construction time, and query time. Years of research now enable modern perfect hash functions to be extremely fast to query, very space-efficient, and scale to billions of keys. Different approaches give different trade-offs between these aspects. For example, the smallest constructions get within 0.1% of the space lower bound of $\log_2(e)$ bits per key. Others are particularly fast to query, requiring only one memory access. Perfect hashing has many applications, for example to avoid collision resolution in static hash tables, and is used in databases, bioinformatics, and stringology.
Since the last comprehensive survey in 1997, significant progress has been made. This survey covers the latest developments and provides a starting point for getting familiar with the topic. Additionally, our extensive experimental evaluation can serve as a guide to select a perfect hash function for use in applications.

44241832.article_summary: 本文综述了现代最小完美哈希函数的研究进展。给定一个包含 $n$ 个键的集合 $S$，完美哈希函数能将这些键无碰撞地映射到前 $m \geq n$ 个整数，其中最小完美哈希函数满足 $m = n$。现代最小完美哈希函数在查询速度、空间效率和扩展性方面取得了显著进展，能够有效处理数十亿个键。不同方法在空间消耗、构建时间和查询时间上各有权衡。本文总结了最新发展，并通过大量实验评估指导实际应用中的选择。该技术广泛应用于静态哈希表、数据库、生物信息学和字符串学等领域。
44241832.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：完美哈希（Perfect Hashing）的应用、优势、实现方式及其在实际开发中的限制和挑战。

不同观点：
• [tmostak] 认为完美哈希在数据库系统（如HeavyDB）中非常有效，尤其是在强分组和连接性能方面。他指出，完美哈希不仅适用于整数和字典编码字符串，还可以用于分箱数值和日期范围等场景。他也提到，虽然需要一个好的基线哈希路径作为后备，但很多实际应用都可以通过完美哈希获得显著性能提升。

• [hinkley] 认为完美哈希的讨论有些学术化，因为前期成本往往较高。不过，现代编程语言能够在编译时运行函数，从而实现静态查找表。他提到一个使用完美哈希加速接口/特性函数调用的研究，显示了其在特定场景下的应用潜力。

• [o11c] 分享了一个纯算术的练习，尝试对ASCII符号进行唯一哈希，并强调了避免使用大数组以减少不必要的资源消耗。他认为分支预测和乘法等操作对性能的影响需要仔细考虑。

data.title: Airlines Don't Want You to Know They Sold Your Flight Data to DHS
data.author: walterbell
data.article_summary: 文章披露，美国主要航空公司拥有的数据经纪公司航空报告公司（ARC）收集国内航班乘客的详细信息，包括姓名、行程和财务信息，并将其出售给海关与边境保护局（CBP）。根据协议，CBP被要求不透露数据来源。此举引发了公民自由专家的担忧，因为这些数据可用于追踪特定人员的旅行记录，支持联邦、州和地方执法机构的调查。ARC由达美航空、美联航等主要航空公司控制，其旅行情报计划（TIP）每天更新数据，包含超过10亿条记录。尽管获取此类数据无需 warrant，但专家指出，政府通过数据经纪商绕过了重要的监督和限制机制。CBP与ARC的合同始于2024年6月，可能延续至2029年。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：[政府通过数据经纪商购买公民出行数据的行为是否合理，及其背后的隐私问题]

不同观点：
• [dnissley] 认为政府在已经有乘客数据的情况下，还额外付费从数据经纪商购买这些数据是浪费资源。他质疑政府为何不直接使用已有的数据，反而要重复购买。

• [rafram] 从法律角度出发，认为政府通过购买数据来规避搜查令，直接获取公民信息，违反了第四修正案关于隐私保护的精神，并对法院尚未制止这种行为表示惊讶。

• [marssaxman] 表示对政府付费购买数据并不惊讶，只是对国土安全部（DHS）需要为此付费感到意外，暗示数据买卖在政府机构中可能早已是常态。

• [bgun] 提出政府通过购买数据，可以省去自行开发和维护内部API的成本，虽然代价是牺牲公民的隐私，但隐私在政策优先级中似乎从未被重视。

• [dorianjp] 以讽刺的语气希望政府购买数据时能得到一个好价格，并提到类似的情况如汽车公司将驾驶行为数据以极低价格卖给保险公司，暗示数据交易中的不公平现象。

• [chiefalchemist] 强调数据来源的透明度问题，指出海关与边境保护局（CBP）购买数据时被要求不透露数据来源，并批评政府对隐私保护的立法缺失，导致数据可以通过非法律渠道直接购买。

• [LorenPechtel] 对政府通过购买而非直接获取数据感到惊讶，并假设政府已经掌握所有美国航空公司和美国境内订票的航班信息，质疑为何还需要通过第三方购买数据。

补充讨论：
- 数据购买的合法性和隐私保护问题，特别是政府是否通过合法途径获取数据，以及公民隐私是否得到足够保护。
- 数据交易的市场现象，例如数据以极低价格被出售，反映出数据买卖中的不平等和不透明。
- 政府部门依赖外部数据经纪商获取数据，而非使用自有系统，可能涉及效率和成本问题。
- 政府是否已经掌握了大部分出行数据，购买数据是否属于重复消费。

A data broker
owned by the country’s major airlines, including Delta, American Airlines, and United, collected US travelers’ domestic flight records, sold access to them to Customs and Border Protection (CBP), and then as part of the contract told CBP to not reveal where the data came from, according to internal CBP documents obtained by 404 Media. The data includes passenger names, their full flight itineraries, and financial details.
This article was created in partnership with
404
Media
, a journalist-owned publication covering how technology impacts humans. For more stories like this,
sign up here
.
CBP, a part of the Department of Homeland Security (DHS), says it needs this data to support state and local police to track people of interest’s air travel across the country, in a purchase that has alarmed civil liberties experts.
The documents reveal for the first time in detail why at least one part of DHS purchased such information, and comes after Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE)
detailed its own
purchase of the data. The documents also show for the first time that the data broker, called the Airlines Reporting Corporation (ARC), tells government agencies not to mention where it sourced the flight data from.
“The big airlines—through a shady data broker that they own called ARC—are selling the government bulk access to Americans' sensitive information, revealing where they fly and the credit card they used,” senator Ron Wyden said in a statement.
ARC is owned and operated by at least eight major US airlines, other
publicly released documents show
. The company’s
board of directors
include representatives from Delta, Southwest, United, American Airlines, Alaska Airlines, JetBlue, and European airlines Lufthansa and Air France, and Canada’s Air Canada. More than
240 airlines depend on ARC
for ticket settlement services.
ARC’s other lines of business include being the conduit between airlines and travel agencies,
finding travel trends
in data with other firms like Expedia, and fraud prevention, according to material on ARC’s YouTube channel and website. The sale of US fliers’ travel information to the government is part of ARC’s Travel Intelligence Program (TIP).
A
Statement of Work included in the newly obtained documents
, which describes why an agency is buying a particular tool or capability, says CBP needs access to ARC’s TIP product “to support federal, state, and local law enforcement agencies to identify persons of interest’s US domestic air travel ticketing information.” 404 Media obtained the documents through a Freedom of Information Act (FOIA) request.
The new documents obtained by 404 Media also show ARC asking CBP to “not publicly identify vendor, or its employees, individually or collectively, as the source of the Reports unless the Customer is compelled to do so by a valid court order or subpoena and gives ARC immediate notice of same.”
The Statement of Work says that TIP can show a person’s paid intent to travel and tickets purchased through travel agencies in the US and its territories. The data from the Travel Intelligence Program (TIP) will provide “visibility on a subject’s or person of interest’s domestic air travel ticketing information as well as tickets acquired through travel agencies in the U.S. and its territories,” the documents say. They add that this data will be “crucial” in both administrative and criminal cases.
A
DHS Privacy Impact Assessment (PIA) available online
says that TIP data is updated daily with the previous day’s ticket sales, and contains more than one billion records spanning 39 months of past and future travel. The document says TIP can be searched by name, credit card, or airline, but ARC contains data from ARC-accredited travel agencies, such as Expedia, and not flights booked directly with an airline. “If the passenger buys a ticket directly from the airline, then the search done by ICE will not show up in an ARC report,” that PIA says. The PIA notes that the data impacts both US and non-US persons, meaning it does include information on US citizens.
WIRED has made this article free for all to read because it is primarily based on reporting from Freedom of Information Act requests.
Please consider subscribing to support our journalism
.
“While obtaining domestic airline data—like many other transaction and purchase records—generally doesn't require a warrant, there's still supposed to go through a legal process that ensures independent oversight and limits data collection to records that will support an investigation,” Jake Laperruque, deputy director of the Center for Democracy & Technology's Security and Surveillance Project, told 404 Media in an email. “As with many other types of sensitive and revealing data, the government seems intent on using data brokers to buy their way around important guardrails and limits.”

data.title: R9: Plan 9 in Rust
data.author: classichasclass
data.article_summary: R9是一个用Rust重写的Plan 9内核项目，受原版Plan 9源码启发并部分基于它。使用Cargo和xtask模式构建内核，支持x86_64和aarch64架构（目前仅支持Raspberry Pi 3）。构建需要llvm-objcopy，并可通过QEMU运行。R9尚未自托管，但可在Raspberry Pi等真实硬件上运行，通过TFTP服务器进行网络启动。项目文件包括构建脚本、配置文件及必要的文档，如README和LICENSE。R9主要使用Rust编写，包含少量汇编和链接脚本。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：R9操作系统项目的技术方向选择，尤其是编程语言和编译器的选择。

不同观点：
• [lproven] 认为继续开发基于Plan 9的项目是值得赞赏的，但对选择Rust语言表示怀疑。他认为Rust还不够成熟，尤其是GCC Rust，并且LLVM非常庞大和复杂，与Plan 9简洁快速的C语言设计理念背道而驰。他建议考虑其他语言，如Go、D、Ada等，尤其是将Inferno与Golang结合可能更符合Plan 9的传统。

• [vdupras] 关心R9项目是否计划实现自举（self-hosting）。他指出，如果一个小型系统需要依赖一个非常庞大的编译器，这在比例上是不协调的，尤其是如果编译器无法在32位地址空间内运行，这将显得非常不合适。

• [leoh] 简短地表示对项目的赞赏，称其为“优雅”，但没有深入讨论技术细节。

补充讨论：
• [lproven] 强调了Plan 9的C语言版本相比标准C更为简洁和高效的特点，并提出Rust和LLVM的引入可能违背这一初衷。他进一步建议，如果要引入新语言，可以考虑其他C的替代语言，如D、Ada、Crystal、Hare或Nim等。

• [vdupras] 提出了对项目技术可行性的担忧，尤其是编译器大小和系统自举能力之间的矛盾，这可能影响项目的整体设计方向。

争议焦点：R9项目中引入Rust语言和LLVM编译器的合理性，以及该选择是否符合Plan 9简洁高效的设计哲学。此外，项目是否应实现自举以及编译器的大小问题也是讨论的争议点。

r9
Plan 9
in Rust
R9 is a reimplementation of the plan9 kernel in Rust.  It is
not only inspired by but in many ways derived from the original
Plan 9
source code.
Building
We use
cargo
and the
xtask
pattern to build the kernel.
To build r9 for x86_64, we assume you have cloned the git repository
somewhere convenient.  Then simply change into the top-level
directory and,
cargo xtask build --arch x86-64
.
To build for aarch64, run
cargo xtask build --arch aarch64
(Currently only Raspberry Pi 3 is supported).
There are other useful
xtask
subcommands; run
cargo xtask help
to see what is available.
Right now, r9 is not self-hosting.
Runtime Dependencies
cargo xtask dist
, which
cargo xtask qemu
depends on, requires
llvm-objcopy
.
This is expected to live in the rust toolchain path.  You can install by running:
rustup component add llvm-tools
If you get
No such file or directory (os error 2)
messages,
then install
llvm
separate from the rust toolchain and set:
OBJCOPY=$(which llvm-objcopy) cargo xtask qemukvm
If
No such file or directory (os error 2)
messages persist,
check to ensure
qemu
or
qemu-kvm
is installed and the
qemu-system-x86_64
binary is in your path (or
qemu-system-aarch64
in the case of aarch64).
Running on Qemu
R9 can be run using qemu for the various supported architectures:
Arch
Platform
Commandline
aarch64
raspi3b
cargo xtask qemu --arch aarch64 --verbose
aarch64
raspi4b
cargo xtask qemu --arch aarch64 --config raspi4b --verbose
x86-64
q35
cargo xtask qemu --arch x86-64 --verbose
x86-64 (with kvm)
q35
cargo xtask qemu --arch x86-64 --kvm --verbose
riscv
virt
cargo xtask qemu --arch riscv64 --verbose
Running on Real Hardware™️
R9 has been run on the following hardware to a greater or lesser degree:
Raspberry Pi 4 (Gets as far as printing 'r9' via the miniuart)
Raspberry Pi, Netboot
Assuming you can set up a TFTP server (good luck, it's incredibly fiddly, but for what it's worth, dnsmasq can work occasionally), and assuming the location of your netboot directory, you can build and copy the binary using the following command:
cargo xtask dist --arch aarch64 --verbose && cp target/aarch64-unknown-none-elf/debug/aarch64-qemu.gz ../netboot/kernel8.img
This copies a compressed binary, which should be much faster to copy across the network.
The Raspberry Pi firmware loads
config.txt
before the kernel.  Here we can set which UART to use, amongst other things.  The following contents will set up to use the miniuart:
enable_uart=1
core_freq_min=500

data.author: eldog_
data.article_summary:
Tom Nixon在2025年5月8日撰文介绍了他自制的一台小型CNC路由器，主要用于制作电路板。该设备工作体积为106 x 104 x 20毫米，整体尺寸为300 x 250 x 200毫米，能处理0.5毫米间距的FR4电路板，并可切割铝材。Nixon的动机源于看到Scanlime使用Bantam Tools桌面铣床制作电路板，虽然CNC铣削并非制作电路板的最优方法，且其他方法如蚀刻或PCB打样服务更便宜便捷，但他看重CNC的多功能性和自制体验。

设计目标包括：至少100x100毫米的工作面积，约15毫米的作业高度，能使用标准刀具，并具备足够的刚性和精度以处理FR4材料和铝材。市面上的机器要么太大、太贵，要么不符合需求，因此Nixon自行设计。

该CNC采用龙门结构，由2020铝型材构成，X和Z轴使用单根MGN12H导轨，Y轴使用两根，均由NEMA17步进电机驱动。尽管看似单薄，但短小的尺寸和紧凑的设计使其刚性足够。Nixon还考虑了升级方案，如将X轴导轨替换为更坚固的型材和导轨组合。

44234200.article_content:
Tom Nixon
about
Building a Tiny
CNC
Router for Making Circuit Boards
08 May 2025
I built a tiny
CNC
router for making circuit boards, and more. It has a working
volume of 106 x 104 x 20 mm
[0]
and occupies a space of about 300 x 250 x 200 mm.
It can be used to make
FR4
circuit boards with 0.5 mm pitch components, and can
cut aluminium.
Here are two example circuit boards, and experiments in acrylic and aluminium:
Motivation
I saw Scanlime using a Bantam Tools desktop milling machine to make a circuit
board on a live stream. It looked so convenient, and I couldn’t get the idea of
having something like that out of my head.
Of course,
CNC
milling is objectively the worst way to obtain circuit boards by
most metrics.
PCB
prototyping services are cheaper, have better capabilities, and are more
convenient. On the other hand, I find that being slow (say, a week vs. an
hour), paying every time, and paying for board area tends to make me
procrastinate and spend lots of time perfecting and checking designs.
Etching is definitely cheaper and can achieve higher quality, but requires
dealing with dangerous chemicals (not ideal in a carpeted rented flat…), is a
single-purpose process, and also requires a fair amount of stuff. In some ways,
the capabilities are worse, as a router can naturally make nice board outlines,
mounting holes, and slots. In some ways, making double-sided boards is also
easier than using etching.
The router mainly competes against hand-wiring prototypes/one-off projects on
perfboard, which I find to be tedious. It always takes longer than I
expect, and the result is often unsatisfying as it’s very easy to make
mistakes, which are messy to fix. Perfboard prototypes are also just not very
good in today’s world where all components are surface-mount and all signals
are high frequency.
I’ve also been lurking in the hobby
CNC
community for a while, and wanted a
piece of the action. I don’t have the space for big second hand junk, so tiny
first-hand junk will have to do.
Criteria
My approximate design goals were:
Working area: at least 100 x 100 mm.
Working height: enough for a circuit board, work-holding and a spoil-board, ~15 mm.
Tools: able to use standard 38.1 x 3.175 mm tooling, with enough travel to
change tools over the workpiece.
All performance aspects (motion system stiffness, maximum force, backlash,
and resolution; spindle speed, power and run-out etc) enough for:
FR4
isolation routing (high
RPM
, 0.1 mm resolution on X and Y, 0.01 mm
resolution on Z)
FR4
cut-out in a reasonable time
cutting aluminium would be nice
Small and light enough to be easily moved around and stored when not in use.
I had a look around for off-the-shelf machines; everything I found was too big
and too expensive for the capabilities I wanted. The old Bantam Tools milling
machines looked appropriate, but they don’t make them any more, and they were
expensive for what they are.
I also spent a while looking at existing designs. Most generic machines are too
big.
“The Ant”
looks quite
close. The resulting circuit boards look nice, but there are some aspects which
seem less sturdy than I’d like. I’m also not keen on building on top of a
proprietary design: the design sources are not available, only the outputs.
Motion System Design
Here’s the machine labelled with terminology and axis names:
It’s a gantry-style machine built from 2020 aluminium extrusion. The X and Z
axes use a single
MGN12H
(clone) linear rail and carriage, while the Y axis
uses two. The X and Y axes are driven by belts, which are directly driven by
NEMA17
0.9 degree stepper motors. The Z axis uses a lead-screw and
anti-backlash nut driven by a small
NEMA14
stepper motor.
This sounds quite flimsy by conventional standards, barely different from a 3D
printer, but in reality it’s stiff enough to meet the above criteria.
The rationale for this is as follows:
The whole machine is tiny, for example the gantry is only 205 mm long between
supports. Since the deflection of a beam in three point loading is
proportional to its length cubed, this makes a big difference — making the X
axis 50 mm longer would approximately halve the stiffness of the frame. This
also makes the belts short, which helps.
The motion system was designed so that the cutting forces are generated as
close to the rails as possible, to minimise torque. The X axis rail sees the
most torque, but is still only 50 mm away from the typical cutter position.
Without measuring, the X axis rail is a good candidate for an upgrade — the
simplest option would be to replace the gantry with a 20 x 40 mm extrusion,
and use two
MGN9
rails with two blocks each, which are smaller but can sit side-by-side.
Belt drives were chosen  for X and Y because they are cheap, compact, simple
and inherently zero-backlash. To make it stiff, I used large stepper motors,
a 10 mm
GT2
belt, small 16 tooth pulleys, and high belt tension.
The steppers have a holding torque of 46 N.cm, or 90 N with a 16 tooth pulley.

Ryan Fleury

140

Demystifying Debuggers, Part 1: A Busy Intersection

Share
Part 1 in a series.
Debuggers exist at the intersection of many parts of the computing ecosystem—they must contend with intricate details of kernels, compilers, linkers, programming languages, and instruction set architectures.
My familiarity with debuggers has improved my programming abilities, the utility of debuggers in my day-to-day programming, and my general knowledge of computing. Back in January,
the RAD Debugger
—the project I work on full-time—was open sourced to the public, to mark the start of its open alpha phase. I’ve been working on the debugger, or the technology on which it depends, for almost four years full-time now. The project has taught me an enormous number of lessons, through exposure to an enormous number of problems. There is still a lot of work to do, and so I expect it will continue to do so, for many years to come.
But perhaps most importantly, debuggers are an intricate piece of the puzzle of the design of a development platform—a future I become more interested in every day, given the undeniable decay infecting modern computing devices and their software ecosystems.
To emphasize their importance, I’d like to reflect on the name “debugger”. It is not a name I would’ve chosen, because it can give the impression that a debugger is an auxiliary, only-relevant-when-things-break tool. Of course, a debugger is
used to debug
—which is why it was named as such—but it is also enormously useful to analyze
working
code’s behavior, and to verify code’s correctness, with respect to the expectations of the code.
A good debugger provides clear and insightful visualizations into what code is doing. As such, they are also enormously useful educational tools—for beginners and experts alike—because they make what is normally opaque, visible. They provide these features by dynamically interacting with running programs—as such, they can also dynamically modify code. At the limit, this approximates (or employs) JIT-compilation and hot-reloading, making traditional compiled toolchains have much more runtime flexibility for developers.
For these reasons, “debugger” is much too special-purpose of a name for the full set of capabilities that debuggers actually provide—they offer glimpses into the lower level inner-workings of a computer. If one designed a computing system from scratch, they might not ideally be independent from the operating system itself. Instead, perhaps the same capabilities could simply be provided through first-class visualization and dynamic execution adjustment features that the operating system naturally exposes. But that is a topic for another day.
I hope this sheds light on the imbecility of Internet debates about the utility of debuggers—for example, where one might find comments like, “I don’t need debuggers, because I can just use
printf
”, or “I don’t need debuggers if I can statically guarantee correctness”. It’s akin to suggesting that someone does not benefit from vision, because they can feel their way around with a mobility cane, or read text through Braille. Even though mobility canes and Braille are obviously good inventions for people who can’t have vision, that doesn’t somehow imply that vision isn’t an obvious benefit, or that it isn’t obviously preferable. Similarly, even though logging and static verification are obviously good inventions for programs or circumstances which cannot be easily debugged at runtime, or when those things are simply preferable in context, that doesn’t somehow imply that actively visualizing the runtime execution of programs through a debugger isn’t an obvious net benefit, or that it isn’t obviously preferable in many cases. To suggest otherwise in either case is absurd. The more useful debuggers become, the shorter the iteration loop of the programmer, the more efficient software production becomes, and the more trivially that programmers can obtain true from-first-principles reasoning about their code.
Given their importance for both the present and future, and their utility to myself (and thus perhaps readers), I’m writing a series explaining and documenting debugger architecture.
In this series of posts, I’ll cover the following topics:
The Anatomy Of A Running Program
— On the concepts involved in a running program. What happens, exactly, when you double click an executable file, or launch it from the command line, and it begins to execute?
Debugger-Kernel Interaction
— On how kernels collect and expose information about program execution to debuggers, like “debug events”, encoding changes like thread creation & destruction, dynamic module loading

data.title: Why Koreans ask what year you were born
data.author: bryanhogan
data.article_summary: 在韩国，年龄非常重要，人们常在初次见面时询问出生年份。这是由于韩国文化中严格的等级制度，年龄决定人与人之间的尊重和互动方式。例如，只有同龄人才能称为“친구/chingu”（朋友），且对年长者需用敬语。韩语有七种敬语级别，年长者对年幼者说话可较为随意，而年幼者则需表现尊重。称呼他人时，常使用称号而非名字，直接用“你”（너/neo）被认为不礼貌。此外，韩国使用两种年龄计算方法：国际年龄和韩国年龄。韩国年龄在出生时算一岁，每年元旦加一岁，因此可能比国际年龄大一两岁。尽管韩国正逐步采用国际年龄标准，但韩国年龄在社会中仍具影响力。了解出生年份有助于避免年龄计算的混淆。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：不同文化中的称谓与尊卑关系，尤其是涉及年龄和资历的规则

不同观点：
• **dkga**：在巴西，尊卑称谓存在地域差异。有些人认为使用非正式称谓（如"você"或"tu"）更加尊重和平等，而其他人则认为对长者和上司使用正式称谓（如"o Senhor/a Senhora"）是尊重。dkga个人觉得强制使用某些正式称谓更像是对服从性的测试，而非真正的尊重。
• **bambax**：作为年长者，bambax更喜欢在邮件或正式场合中被使用姓名称呼，而不是直接用名字。这反映出在某些文化中，使用名字或正式称谓有不同的社会意义。
• **GreyMolecules**：讨论了韩国年龄系统的复杂性，尤其是“빠른”系统，这使得出生在一二月的人可能与前一年出生的人有相同的社交身份。
• **socalgal2**：提到高权力距离文化可能导致负面后果，例如在航空事故中因下属不敢质疑机长决定而发生空难。
• **Leftium**：指出在韩国文化中，使用不符合社交层级的正式语言也可能被视为不礼貌。还提到一些韩国人使用英文名字或昵称来绕过社会层级。
• **kinleyd**：分享了一次在韩国因未遵循年龄尊卑规则而险些遭遇冲突的个人经历，表明这些规则在日常生活中有实际影响。
• **whensean**：认为这种基于年龄的社会层级制度阻碍了创新和社会发展，并指出中国受儒家文化影响但没有类似的繁琐礼节。
• **gnabgib**：提到韩国废除“韩国年龄”制度，表明这种复杂的年龄计算方式在现代社会中逐渐被简化。
• **Noelia-**：对韩国人通过询问出生年份来确定如何称呼对方的做法感到有趣，并指出这种做法在其他文化中可能显得突兀或不礼貌。
• **daft_pink**：讨论了日语中的礼仪和社会层级如何影响语言学习，尤其是对非母语者来说。
• **lvl155**：认为韩国人在国外时仅在有利时遵循年龄层级规则，表明这种文化在某些情况下被选择性应用。
• **bitbasher**：分享了在学习日语时因未遵循社交层级而遭遇误解的经历，强调了在某些文化中社交互动规则的重要性。
• **null_deref**：提到韩国人在同一年成为法定饮酒年龄可能带来一些有趣的记忆，表明这种制度也有其积极的一面。
• **netsharc**：讨论了不同文化中计算年龄的方式，指出有些人可能在29岁时就开始庆祝30年的生活。

补充讨论：
• **争议焦点**：是否应遵循严格的尊卑称谓规则，以及这些规则是否真正代表尊重。dkga和whensean等人认为这些规则可能导致不必要的距离和服从性测试，而其他人如bambax和Leftium则认为适当的称谓是尊重和文化的一部分。
• **文化差异**：评论中多次提到不同文化中对年龄和尊卑称谓的不同看法，如巴西、韩国、日本和法国，反映了全球范围内对这一问题的多样性。
• **实际案例**：许多评论者分享了个人经历，如dkga在巴西的经历和kinleyd在韩国商店的遭遇，这些案例说明了在实际生活中不遵循当地尊卑规则可能导致的后果。

总体而言，讨论围绕着文化中的尊卑称谓规则展开，涉及其背后的尊重观念、社会影响以及在不同文化中的实际应用。

44244879.article_content:
One thing that was surprising for me in South Korea was how important age is.
Meeting new people in Korea they would often ask very early on what year I was born. But why? In Germany, people generally don’t really care that much about your age. In Korea there are several reasons why age matters though.
Showing Respect & You
You can’t be “friends” if you are not born in the same year. At least, the word “친구 / chingu” which translates to “friend” is only used between people born in the same year. You can still be friends with anyone regardless of what your age is, but there is a tendency to be with people born in the same year as you for multiple reasons.
In Korean culture age matters, you should always show respect to your elders and any people older than you.
There is a more strict hierarchy which is purely decided by age.
This is also heavily rooted into the language. There are 7 different speech levels, although only 6 are actually used. They are all used to show different levels of respect depending on which formality and politeness would be adequate towards the listener.
So the older person usually talks “down” to the younger person, and the younger person has to talk “up” to show the older person more respect.
The younger person also addresses the older person, usually with a title or another word that fits their relationship, but not their name. Only the older person addresses the younger one with their name. (
There can be more nuance.
)
Using “you” in Korean is quite interesting since the direct translation 너 / neo is often too rude. Instead you can:
Just don’t, omit the “you”
Use titles instead (“선생님 / seonsaengnim” for teacher, “사장님 / sajangnim” for manager)
Use “언니 / Unnie” , “오빠 / Oppa”, “누나 / Noona” or “형 / Hyung” (for an older friend)
“그쪽 / geujjok” (stranger momentarily, can be rude, avoided by many)
Name + 씨 / ssi
당신 / dangsin (spouse, songs, speeches)
너 / neo (it’s highly impolite, good for starting fights, okay for close friends)
So one of the main reasons why age matters in Korea is to understand the relation between the two of you.
The Different Ages
But why ask for the year born and not age?
Well, Koreans might still ask how old and if you then answer with an amount of years that might lead to confusion. “Which one?” could be a possible reaction to your answer.
Which one? In Korea you will find that people use two different kinds of counting systems for age, the international age and the Korean age.
The international age is what I was used to, but what is Korean age?
In Korean age you are born with 1 and you gain a year on January 1st. Yes, every person gains a year at the beginning of the calendar year. This means that your Korean age is always one or two years more than your international age.
This can lead to the funny situation of someone who’s born on December 31st being two years old the next day in Korean age after not even spending one whole day on this earth.
South Korea is shifting over to use international age more and more, they even formally adopted to the international age standard in June 2023. But Korean age is still deeply ingrained into society and still relevant. For example, the legal drinking age in Korea is 20 in Korean age.
So one solution to make things easier in a conversation, is to just ask for the birth year instead.

e-mail
or at any of my social media spaces!

data.title: Ask HN: What is the latest on treatment of Metastatic Breast Cancer?
data.author: hazrmard
data.article_summary: 无法获取文章内容
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：乳腺癌的治疗和辅助方法，尤其是肠道微生物群调节和其他替代或补充疗法。

不同观点：
• [pella] 认为肠道微生物群调节（如粪便微生物群移植）是当前转移性乳腺癌治疗中最受关注的辅助方法之一。他引用了几篇学术文章，指出肠道微生物的组成可能有助于预测对免疫治疗的反应，调节肠道微生物群有可能增强化疗-免疫治疗的效果。然而，现有的相关数据仍然有限，需要更大规模的前瞻性研究来进一步阐明其作为 biomarker 和治疗手段的作用。

• [g42gregory] 提出了一个不同的或补充的观点，强调了重新利用药物和代谢干预在乳腺癌治疗中的潜在应用。他引用了 IMA Health 网站上的研究，认为这些方法可能适用于癌症治疗。

• [yread] 指出乳腺癌的治疗效果取决于多种因素，包括癌症的亚型（如ER、PR、HER2状态）。特别提到三阴性乳腺癌中，一些患者如果免疫系统高度活跃（如高 TILs），可能可以避免化疗。

补充讨论：
• [pella] 强调了当前研究的局限性，指出需要更多的研究来验证肠道微生物群调节在乳腺癌治疗中的实际效果。

• [g42gregory] 的观点补充了其他治疗方法的可能性，尤其是药物重新利用和代谢干预，这可能为乳腺癌治疗提供新的思路。

• [yread] 提到了个体化治疗的重要性，尤其是根据乳腺癌的不同亚型和免疫系统状态来选择合适的治疗方案。

争议焦点：
• 肠道微生物群调节在乳腺癌治疗中的实际效果和应用前景仍存在争议，主要因为现有研究数据的有限性。
• 不同治疗方法（如粪便微生物群移植、药物重新利用、代谢干预）的适用性和有效性在不同乳腺癌亚型中的表现可能不同，需要更多的临床研究来验证。

总结：评论者们讨论了多种乳腺癌的辅助治疗方法，包括肠道微生物群调节、药物重新利用和代谢干预，强调了现有研究的局限性和个体化治疗的重要性。

• [pella] 强调了当前研究的局限性，指出需要更多的研究来验证肠道微生物群调节在乳腺癌治疗中的实际效果。

• [g42gregory] 的观点补充了其他治疗方法的可能性，尤其是药物重新利用和代谢干预，这可能为乳腺癌治疗提供新的思路。

• [yread] 提到了个体化治疗的重要性，尤其是根据乳腺癌的不同亚型和免疫系统状态来选择合适的治疗方案。

争议焦点：
• 肠道微生物群调节在乳腺癌治疗中的实际效果和应用前景仍存在争议，主要因为现有研究数据的有限性。
• 不同治疗方法（如粪便微生物群移植、药物重新利用、代谢干预）的适用性和有效性在不同乳腺癌亚型中的表现可能不同，需要更多的临床研究来验证。

总结：评论者们讨论了多种乳腺癌的辅助治疗方法，包括肠道微生物群调节、药物重新利用和代谢干预，强调了现有研究的局限性和个体化治疗的重要性。

data.article_summary: 本文介绍了19世纪德国贵族赫尔曼·冯·皮克勒-穆斯考（Hermann von Pückler-Muskau）伯爵的生平及其对造园艺术的贡献。皮克勒因其厨师以他命名的一种冰淇淋而闻名，但他本人更以造园艺术著称。他撰写的《造园艺术提示》一书详细介绍了从移植树木到防止破坏的各类技巧。文章指出，造园如同设计软件或游戏环境，需在有限空间中创造令人愉悦的路径和景观。路径的弯曲应有合理性，以增强行走体验。此外，景观设计应控制前景，隐藏主要景观以增加期待感，避免过度展示。文章还通过《塞尔达传说》和《合金装备5》等游戏的例子，说明现代设计中如何应用这些原则，强调适时给予视觉释放以增强体验。造园的本质是模仿自然的人工艺术，需注重细节以达到自然效果。

• **学术与兴趣阅读**：mock-possum表示对Pückler书籍的兴趣，认为其设计原则可以应用于人类体验设计，这种观点强调了对特定领域知识的跨学科应用。

he Fiefdom of Files
Lessons from That 1834
Landscape Gardening Guidebook
7th of June, 2025
H
ermann Ludwig Heinrich Count of Pückler-Muskau was born in 1785 to the Earl Pückler and was later granted sovereignty over his land by King Friedrich III. His fame is unbroken today, but not because of his political power, but because his house chef named a dessert after him. In German and Dutch, the now popular combination of chocolate, vanilla and strawberry ice cream is called
Pückler Ice Cream
.
When the count wasn't busy snacking on novelty sweets, he liked to engage in his other favorite activity — landscape gardening. Having traveled through England at length, he developed a taste for this exclusive art and lamented that his compatriot aristocrats in Prussia were content with comparatively poorly designed pleasure grounds. To educate and promote good style, he authored the classic
Hints on Landscape Gardening
.
The work is simply great fun to read today. It covers all aspects of the landscaping process, starting with basics like how to transplant trees and moving all the way to advanced topics, like how to prevent commoners from chopping the trees back down.
Perhaps our own estate is too small to host a Bowling Green, a Hunter's Lodge or even a simple Pavilion, but the presented ideas are still useful to toy with. Landscaping a park is the archetypal example of making an environment. Whether we're writing an IDE, designing an open-world RPG, or making a maze for your pet rat, these lessons apply.
Parks are a bit awkward. They are space-constrained, but designed to be walked around in for a long time. This leads to the need for winding paths, which are again awkward. "Why do I have to walk around this corner when I could just go straight?" is a natural reaction of anyone traversing an artificially curved path: "Oh right, I'm doing this for leisure." It reminds us of that suspicion that our life is pointless, which is rather rude.
The solution to artificial pointlessness is an artificial point. We give the path a reason to curve. The figures show four ways to make a simple curve more enjoyable to walk through. Just imagine the betrayal you would feel if the tree or hill wasn't there, and how satisfying these are in comparison.
The user wants to see why the path curves is necessary, even if the real reason is invisible. It is not enough that our solution is the best option; it has to look like the best option
locally
to be acceptable. We learn a first lesson.
1)
Show the obstacle.
Having solved the curve problem, the park might end up more fun to walk through than if we hadn't been space-constrained at all. Pückler writes that a big park often gives one great view, but only that —
one
great view. If you have an expensive castle and a huge estate, it's hard not to show it off. The comparison of St. Peter's Basilica to the Pantheon is given: Because the basilica is more than triple the height of the Pantheon, the main dome with an identical radius ends up looking unimpressively small.
In landscape gardening, we can avoid boring the visitor with show-offs by controlling the foreground. A particularly pretty sight should stay hidden for most of the route, or at least partially obscured. Then, finally, we draw the shrubs out of the line of sight as the path homes in on the spectacle. Such anticipation, such drama! The foreground is much cheaper to control, and thus allows more iterations. Instead of moving the castle, we move the shrubberies.
A modern example, both good and bad, are the recent open-world additions to the
Legend of Zelda
series. Undoubtedly they have great map design, but incessantly clearing sight by climbing on everything disenchants the well-designed landscapes. From a landscape gardening perspective, the final boss isn't Ganon, but that mechanic of climbing a vantage point tower all the time. Reflecting on different locations, it seems like the narrative tension is inverse proportional to how much is actually visible on the screen. In contrast, the gray rocks that surround the camera in
Metal Gear Solid V
feel weirdly engaging, because said rocks are always nicely framed by the foreground serving as Snake's cover.
The castle of our park shouldn't be readily visible. We keep the visual (auditory et cetera) domain empty and only give the cathartic release when we know it's earned. We summarize as:
2)
Hide the castle a bit.
Another reason that parks are fundamentally awkward is that they imitate something they aren't. They want to be nature, but they are artifice. Pückler goes into significant detail describing observed patterns in trees and rivers in order to simulate them properly. For instance, a river will have a shallower edge on the inside of a curve than on the outside, because friction carves away at the dirt. The river on the top is boring and unnatural; the bottom one is interesting and natural:

data.title: AlphaWrite: AI that improves at writing by evolving its own stories
data.author: tamassimond
data.article_summary: 文章介绍了一种名为Alpha Writing的框架，用于提升创意文本生成中的推理计算能力。该方法受进化算法启发，通过迭代故事生成和基于Elo评级的两两比较，逐步提升叙事质量。主要步骤包括：多样化初始故事生成、故事对比与Elo排名更新、以及通过选择和变异进行故事进化。实验表明，该方法能有效提高创意写作的质量，并通过将改进后的故事反馈到基础模型中，实现模型的自我提升。该框架解决了创意领域中缺乏系统化方法来利用额外计算资源的问题，展示了在创意文本生成中通过增加计算资源提升输出质量的潜力。

Code Repository
:
AlphaWrite on GitHub
Large languagenference time compute Scaling for Writing models have demonstrated remarkable improvements in performance through increased inference-time compute on quantitative reasoning tasks, particularly in mathematics and coding. However, the creative domain—where outputs are inherently highly subjective and difficult to evaluate—has seen limited exploration of systematic approaches to scale inference-time compute effectively.
In this work, we introduce Alpha Writing, a novel framework for scaling inference-time compute in creative text generation. Inspired by AlphaEvolve and other evolutionary algorithms, our approach combines iterative story generation with Elo-based evaluation to systematically improve narrative quality. Rather than relying on single-shot generation or simple resampling, Alpha Writing creates a dynamic ecosystem where stories compete, evolve, and improve through multiple generations.
Our method addresses a critical gap in the field: while we can easily scale compute for tasks with clear correctness criteria, creative domains have lacked principled approaches for leveraging additional inference resources. By treating story generation as an evolutionary process guided by pairwise preferences, we demonstrate that creative output quality can be systematically improved through increased compute allocation.
We further demonstrate the scalability of these methods by distilling the enhanced stories back into the base model, creating a stronger foundation for subsequent rounds of Alpha Writing. This recursive cycle—where improved outputs become training data for an enhanced model that can generate even better stories—offers promising potential for self improving writing models.
Methodology
Overview
Alpha Writing employs an evolutionary approach to improve story quality through iterative generation and selection. The process consists of four main stages: (1) diverse initial story generation, (2) pairwise comparison using Elo rankings, and (3) evolutionary refinement of top-performing stories. (2) and (3) are repeated for multiple generations to progressively enhance narrative quality.
Initial Story Generation
To establish a diverse starting population, we generate a large corpus of initial stories with systematic variation. Each story is generated with two randomized parameters:
Author style
: The model is prompted to write in the style of different authors
Theme
: Each generation focuses on a different narrative theme
This approach ensures broad exploration of the creative space and prevents early convergence on a single narrative style or structure.
Judging and Elo Ranking
Stories are evaluated through pairwise comparisons using an LLM judge. The judge is provided with:
A detailed evaluation rubric focusing on narrative quality metrics
Two stories to compare
Instructions to select the superior story
The rubric improves consistency in judgments by providing clear evaluation criteria. Based on these pairwise comparisons, we update Elo ratings for each story, creating a dynamic ranking system that captures relative quality differences. We use base Elo of 1200 and K-factor of 32. For our experiments we use the same model as the judge and generator
Story Evolution
After establishing rankings through pairwise comparisons, we implement an evolutionary process to iteratively improve story quality:
1. Selection
: Select top-performing stories as foundation for next generation
2. Variation Generation
: Generate variants using randomly sampled improvement objectives (narrative structure, character development, emotional resonance, dialogue, thematic depth, descriptive detail, plot tension, prose style). Random sampling maintains creative diversity.
3. Population Update
: Retain high-performers, replace lower-ranked stories with variants
4. Re-ranking
: Fresh pairwise comparisons on updated population
5. Iteration
: Repeat across generations, allowing successful elements to propagate
Evaluation Protocol
Evaluating creative output presents significant challenges due to subjective preferences and high variance in story content. Our evaluation approach includes:
Model selection
: Focus on smaller models where improvements are more pronounced
Story length
: Restrict to stories under 500 words to enable easier comparison
Prompt design
: Use open-ended prompts to allow models to demonstrate narrative crafting abilities
Data collection
: 120 preference comparisons per experiment to establish statistical significance
Evaluation Protocol:
Evaluators same rubric we use for LLM judge to score which of the two responses they prefer
Initial generations often exhibited fundamental narrative issues including poor story arcs and structural problems, making improvements through evolution particularly noticeable. We compare performance against initial model-generated stories and stories improved through repeated prompting.

s3mini | Tiny & fast S3 client for node and edge platforms.
s3mini
is an ultra-lightweight Typescript client (~14 KB minified, ≈15 % more ops/s) for S3-compatible object storage. It runs on Node, Bun, Cloudflare Workers, and other edge platforms. It has been tested on Cloudflare R2, Backblaze B2, DigitalOcean Spaces, and MinIO. (No Browser support!)

Features
🚀 Light and fast: averages ≈15 % more ops/s and only ~14 KB (minified, not gzipped).
🔧 Zero dependencies; supports AWS SigV4 (no pre-signed requests).
🟠 Works on Cloudflare Workers; ideal for edge computing, Node, and Bun (no browser support).
🔑 Only the essential S3 APIs—improved list, put, get, delete, and a few more.
📦
BYOS3

Bring your own S3-compatible bucket

data.title: The “Frankfurt Kitchen”
data.author: tosh
data.article_summary: "Frankfurt Kitchen"是由维也纳建筑师Margarete Schütte-Lihotzky于1926年设计的标准化原型厨房，旨在提高家务效率，是现代建筑和20世纪20年代日常文化的重要代表。该设计受法兰克福建筑检查员Ernst May委托，作为大规模住房项目的一部分，以解决战后住房短缺问题，并为工人阶级提供卫生和技术标准较高的居住环境。厨房采用模块化系统，减少空间占用并实现批量生产，成为现代整体厨房的原型。它在Römerstadt住宅区的一个联排房屋中展示，尽管缺乏一些原型特点如滑门和保温箱，但配备了煤电组合炉。厨房的设计受到铁路餐车影响，基于科学化的工作流程，旨在作为一个“烹饪工作间”，与起居室隔开。该厨房体现了客观性、功能主义和标准化原则，并反映了包豪斯和Werkbund活动家的意识形态，即通过统一设计消除阶级差异。然而，20世纪70年代和80年代的批评指出，该设计未挑战性别分工问题，默认家务是女性职责。博物馆还展出了相关视听资料和研究成果。

44210649.article_content:
“Frankfurt Kitchen” in the display collection of the Werkbundarchiv – Museum der Dinge, taken from the Römerstadt estate, Frankfurt, 1927/28
© Werkbundarchiv – Museum der Dinge
The “Frankfurt Kitchen” is an important document of cultural history for the transfer of industrial, rationalized work processes to the sphere of the private household. This is a central characteristic of modern architecture and everyday culture in the 1920s.
The Viennese architect Margarete Schütte-Lihotzky designed the kitchen in 1926 as a standard prototype. Some 10,000 such kitchens were realized in numerous variants in the Frankfurt estates. Schütte-Lihotzky was commissioned by the Frankfurt building inspector Ernst May, who was both the architectural designer and the local administrator responsible for the “New Frankfurt” of the 1920s. In view of the scarcity of rental housing in Frankfurt after the First World War, this building programme was intended to produce cheap, efficient housing with an economical use of use space and simple, economical furnishings for a growing population. The housing estate building programme, supported mainly by the SPD, was politically motivated and aimed at providing the technical and hygienic standards of the day — running water, gas and electricity — to the lower classes. The programme was publicized through a modern campaign. As part of that campaign, the kitchen was presented and well received at the Frankfurt spring fair of 1927.
The development of a standardized modular system made it possible to reduce the floor area required, and also permitted mass production which lowered costs further.
The “Frankfurt Kitchen” was widely marketed and became the model for the fitted kitchen of today. There is not just one Frankfurt Kitchen, however. The model underwent several changes during the period in which it was realized in a number of Frankfurt estates until 1930.
The “Frankfurt Kitchen” was designed to be efficient and functional, modeled after railway dining car kitchens, and planned based on taylorized work processes. It was intended to be used as a “cooking workroom”, and divided from the sitting room by a sliding door.
The “Frankfurt Kitchen” specimen in the display collection of the Werkbundarchiv – Museum der Dinge was taken from a two-family terrace house at Heidenfeld 24 in the Römerstadt estate, built in 1927-28. The kitchens in the Römerstadt estate lacked the sliding door and the hay box that is present in other Frankfurt Kitchens, and was equipped with a combination coal/electric cooker. The kitchen cabinets were originally painted blue-green, and were repainted in a cream color during its years of use. The kitchen is exhibited in its unrestored state to show the authentic signs of use and modification. Paint has been removed from the fittings, however, and some missing parts have been replaced.
The ensemble is an ideal addition to the Museum’s collection because the Frankfurt Kitchen illustrates key principles of the 1920s: objectivity, functionalism, and above all, standardization. The concept of standardization was connected not only with production techniques, but also reflected the ideological position of the Bauhaus and Werkbund activists, who saw the uniform design of everyday objects as a contribution towards leveling the differences between classes. The artistic design of the standardized object served to refine it and to ensure that the right form was definitive.
The “Frankfurt Kitchen” was one of the models propagated by the Werkbund and the Bauhaus for the “New Life” of the “New Man”, an idea that was widely popular in the 1920s. These visions involve a renunciation of historically determined elements of identity. Bruno Taut, in his book Die Neue Wohnung (“The New Home”), rejects the presence of mementos and any kind of “historic junk”. Erna Meyer, the academic housekeeping expert of the 1920s and 1930s, wrote: “Now it’s all or nothing: New Man needs a new skin!” (Wohnungsbau und Hausführung, 1927, 89).
A “planned order” was to replace the “senseless chaos” of the world. The notion of a regularly constructed reality corresponds to the principles of functionalism and rationality conditioned by industrial production processes. Both objects and people were to conform to these principles.
The consequences of these reformative initiatives, especially in housing estate architecture, were criticized in debates on socially supported housing in the 1970s and 1980s. The image of women that is evident in the Frankfurt Kitchen concept must also be viewed critically. A purely functional working kitchen was intended to make housework easier, but without questioning the gendered division of labour.
Alongside the actual kitchen exhibited in the museum, visitors can examine an audiovisual installation based on historic photos and films, a 1985 interview with the designing architect, Margarete Schütte-Lihotzky, and the findings of two researchers who spent years studying the Frankfurt Kitche
44210649.article_summary: "Frankfurt Kitchen"是由维也纳建筑师Margarete Schütte-Lihotzky于1926年设计的标准化原型厨房，旨在提高家务效率，是现代建筑和20世纪20年代日常文化的重要代表。该设计受法兰克福建筑检查员Ernst May委托，作为大规模住房项目的一部分，以解决战后住房短缺问题，并为工人阶级提供卫生和技术标准较高的居住环境。厨房采用模块化系统，减少空间占用并实现批量生产，成为现代整体厨房的原型。它在Römerstadt住宅区的一个联排房屋中展示，尽管缺乏一些原型特点如滑门和保温箱，但配备了煤电组合炉。厨房的设计受到铁路餐车影响，基于科学化的工作流程，旨在作为一个“烹饪工作间”，与起居室隔开。该厨房体现了客观性、功能主义和标准化原则，并反映了包豪斯和Werkbund活动家的意识形态，即通过统一设计消除阶级差异。然而，20世纪70年代和80年代的批评指出，该设计未挑战性别分工问题，默认家务是女性职责。博物馆还展出了相关视听资料和研究成果。

data.title: Show HN: DIY virtual HDMI monitor using "AR" glasses
data.author: blensor
data.article_summary: 该项目旨在通过Orange Pi 5 Plus的HDMI输入，利用V4L2设备实现虚拟显示，支持Viture Pro XR眼镜。程序捕获视频并通过OpenGL窗口实时显示，支持IMU集成、测试图案及平面几何控制。当前处于早期开发阶段，性能有待提升。支持平台为Orange Pi 5 Plus，其他单板电脑可通过USB视频采集卡实现。依赖于Linux系统及相关库（如OpenGL、GLUT、libv4l2）。提供多种命令行选项以自定义显示效果，如设备路径、全屏模式、IMU控制、测试图案等。通过快速摇头手势可重置视图旋转。未来计划包括支持更多设备、提升性能及增加功能。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：AR眼镜的功能、使用体验、技术实现及其局限性

不同观点：
• [sitkack] 认为AR眼镜没有提供一个锁定环境中的虚拟屏幕（即屏幕在空间中固定，不受头部移动影响），而这是某些AR眼镜具备的功能，能够克服AR眼镜的缺陷。此外，AR眼镜厂商可能会通过产品升级或分割功能来限制某些特性，项目有可能提供厂商未考虑到或限制的功能。

• [benhoff] 关注硬件驱动的稳定性，特别提到了op5plus的HDMI输入驱动在8-12个月前存在不稳定问题，暗示了对硬件兼容性和驱动稳定性的关注。

• [stavros] 以Xreal Air 2的实际使用体验为例，证实了该项目所实现的功能（虚拟第二屏幕）确实如宣传的那样。不过，他个人只需要一个屏幕，且没有使用相关应用，显示出不同用户对AR眼镜功能需求的差异。

• [xeonmc] 提出如果只有3dof（自由度）跟踪，可以考虑让显示图像没有立体视差，这样可以模拟投影在天空中的屏幕，类似于战斗机和枪械反射瞄准器的工作原理。

• [verdverm] 推荐了Immersed软件，它提供多个虚拟屏幕，并支持所有主要操作系统和VR设备，且未来将推出自己的头显设备（Visor），展示了现有市场上的替代解决方案。

• [wkat4242] 分享了对Xreal Air和Quest 3的使用体验对比，指出Xreal的佩戴舒适性较差，视 prescription镜片问题导致显示不清晰，且重量不均衡。同时，对Quest 3的舒适性和更大的视场角（FoV）给予了肯定，但指出其便携性较差。此外，还提到了对Quest 3连接HDMI dongle功能的兴趣。

• [skeptrune] 对AR眼镜硬件价格的亲民性表示赞赏，认为409美元的价格对硬件爱好者来说非常实惠。

• [LonelyWolfe] 抱怨目前AR眼镜的1080p分辨率不够高，无法替代物理显示器，并与VR设备的高分辨率进行对比，质疑厂商为何不提升分辨率。

• [deivid] 对项目中的“重映射”功能提出疑问，不确定该功能相较于眼镜本身功能的独特之处，并询问了项目是否在将HDMI信号转换为Viture协议。

• [amelius] 对Viture眼镜的瞳距设计提出质疑，认为其设计可能更适合亚洲市场，而不适合西方市场。

• [unsupp0rted] 提出了一种特殊需求，希望AR眼镜使用电子墨水屏（e-ink），以满足特定使用场景的需求。

补充讨论：
• AR眼镜的分辨率问题是一个争议焦点，[LonelyWolfe] 对1080p分辨率的不满与其他用户对产品功能的认可形成对比。
• 不同用户对舒适性和便携性的体验差异显著，[wkat4242] 对Xreal和Quest 3的优缺点进行了详细对比。
• 对项目技术实现的细节存在疑问，[deivid] 对“重映射”功能和信号转换的实现方式表示不解。
• 用户的特殊需求（如[unsupp0rted] 对e-ink屏幕的需求）展示了AR眼镜在特定应用场景中的潜在市场。

V4L2 Viture Virtual Display
Attention
this is
still in early development
and not fully functional yet. It will work but performance needs to be improved a lot.
v4l2_gl captures video from a HDMI-in on an OrangePI 5 Plus using the hdmirx V4L2 device, converts frames to RGB, and displays them in real-time on a textured quad in an OpenGL window. It supports Viture headset IMU integration, test patterns, and plane geometry.
Supported platforms
Orange Pi 5 Plus
To run this as intended you need an OrangePi 5 Plus with armbian ( we are using BredOS ) that has Device Tree Overlays enabled and has the hdmi-rx device tree overlay active.
Other SBCs
If you are using a Raspberry Pi or other device without HDMI-in you need a USB capture card that is supported on your Linux version
Testing without HDMI
For testing purposes you can run it on a laptop with a webcam but that does not provide you with a virtual display.
Dependencies
This requires a linux based OS and installed gcc and build tools.
To compile and run this application, ensure the following libraries are installed:
OpenGL and GLUT libraries
:
These are essential for creating the window and rendering graphics. On Debian/Ubuntu-based systems, you can install them using:
sudo apt update
sudo apt install freeglut3-dev
libv4l2 library
:
sudo apt install libv4l-dev
libhidapi-dev
(optional): If your are using the revers engineered protocol instead of the official Viture SDK
sudo apt install libhidapi-dev
Compilation
Depending on the architecture you are running it on use the reverse engineered protocol version ( ARM ) or the official Viture SDK version ( X86 )
Using the reverse engineered protocol
make
This will generate the executable
v4l2_gl
Using the official Viture SDK
make viture_sdk
This will generate the executable
v4l2_gl_viture_sdk
Running the viewer
Execute the compiled application from your terminal:
sudo ./v4l2_gl [options]
or
sudo ./v4l2_gl_viture_sdk [options]
Recenter view / rotation reset
Quickly shake your head left/right 3 times to reset the rotation to the center position after the IMU has drifted too far.
Command-Line Options
The application supports the following command-line options:
--device <path>
:
Specifies the V4L2 device path (e.g., /dev/video0).
Default:
/dev/video0
.
Example:
./v4l2_gl --device /dev/video1
--fullscreen
:
Runs the application in fullscreen mode.
Default:
false
(disabled).
Example:
./v4l2_gl --fullscreen
--viture
:
Enables integration with Viture headset IMU for controlling the rotation of the displayed plane. The Viture SDK and device must be correctly set up.
Default:
false
(disabled).
Example:
./v4l2_gl --viture
--test-pattern
:
Displays a generated test pattern on the plane instead of the live camera feed. Useful for testing rendering and transformations.
Default:
false
(disabled).
Example:
./v4l2_gl --test-pattern
--plane-distance <distance>
:
Sets the distance at which the plane orbits the world origin.
<distance>
is a floating-point value.
Default:
1.0
.
Example:
./v4l2_gl --plane-distance 0.5
--plane-scale <scale>
:
Sets a scale multiplier for the size of the plane.
<scale>
is a floating-point value (must be > 0).
Default:
1.0
(original size). Values greater than 1.0 enlarge the plane, less than 1.0 shrink it. Values <= 0.0 are reset to 1.0.
Example:
./v4l2_gl --plane-scale 1.5
Combined Example
You can combine these options:
./v4l2_gl --device /dev/video1 --viture --fullscreen --plane-distance 0.8 --plane-scale 1.2 --test-pattern
This command would:
Use V4L2 device
/dev/video1
.
Enable Viture IMU.
Run in fullscreen.
Set the plane orbit distance to 0.8 units.
Scale the plane to 120% of its original size.
Display the test pattern.
Demo
Reset rotation gesture

Support MJPEG format to increase framerate of USB capture cards

Add curved screen option

data.title: Firefox OS's story from a Mozilla insider not working on the project (2024)
data.author: todsacerdoti
data.article_summary: 本文讲述了Mozilla内部人士对Firefox OS项目的回顾。在2011或2012年的一次Mozilla全体会议上，Mozilla推出了Boot 2 Gecko（B2G）项目，旨在开发一个基于Android的开源手机操作系统，以应对移动互联网的快速发展。由于iPhone和Android的崛起，以及Mozilla在移动领域的困境，B2G成为公司重点项目。这导致公司结构从扁平化转向层级化，并增加了项目经理和销售人员。然而，由于各合作伙伴的需求不同，项目进展复杂，质量问题频发。与此同时，Firefox桌面版因资源倾斜而受到忽视。尽管B2G在2015年被中止，Mozilla重新聚焦桌面版，但公司规模已扩大至1200人。作者作为Thunderbird团队的一员，因项目取消而转岗，并对B2G持负面看法，尽管后来对测试机产生兴趣。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：Firefox OS失败的原因及相关技术策略的分析

不同观点：
• nicoburns认为，Firefox OS的基本理念是正确的，即拥有完整的软件栈可以更好地控制设备体验，但开发策略出现了问题。他们过于仓促，忽视了桌面端，且过早地寻求合作伙伴，而产品尚未成熟。另外，选择低端设备作为首要目标是一个重大失误，如果先针对高端设备开发，低端设备的问题可能在后续自然得到解决。同时，Rust语言的发展若能提前，可能会为Firefox OS提供更好的技术基础。

• fidotron指出，Firefox OS失败的主要原因是时机不对，正逢设备图形能力迅速提升的时期，GPU和CPU的性能瓶颈使得系统难以流畅运行。同时，他认为Mozilla缺乏足够的资源和理解来解决这些问题。他还建议，Mozilla应该专注于开发基于Firefox OS的电子阅读器，结合开放平台和电子墨水技术，可能会创造一个可持续的业务。

• bgirard以Mozilla渲染团队成员的身份分享了实际开发中的困难。他提到在优化设备性能时，目标设备的内存从256 MB突然降到64 MB，导致软件体验不佳，进一步打击了对项目的信心。

• afavour从用户角度分析，认为Firefox OS失败的主要原因是缺乏足够的应用程序，而这正是WebOS和Windows Phone也失败的原因。尽管如此，他认为Mozilla的尝试是有意义的，试图通过网络技术打破科技巨头的垄断。

• neilv对Firefox OS的构建过程和隐私安全问题提出了担忧。他认为，基于Android的构建过程引入了大量依赖，且可能威胁到隐私和安全。此外，他担心Firefox OS的商业化方向可能影响其作为一个可信赖的开放平台的发展。

• seba_dos1批评Firefox OS在技术上和哲学上与Android过于相似，尽管使用了Web技术，但并没有在设备开放性和用户自由方面取得显著进展，导致自由软件社区对其兴趣不大。

补充讨论：
